final: WITH by_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_averages FROM by_rating) SELECT b.rating, b.avg_ratio, b.avg_ratio - o.avg_of_averages AS difference FROM by_rating AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE b.avg_ratio > o.avg_of_averages
